Olivia (PM): Quick question — for Q2 experiments on routing + prompt-slicing, do we prioritize low-latency canaries or high-impact A/Bs? Need to pick 3 to kickoff.
Raj (Eng): leaning RICE to pick... we should also consider sequencing — can't run big A/B until canary/fallback plumbing is rock-solid.
Maria (Data Science): Data: customer-facing calls = 210k/mo, avg tokens 90, current eval pass-rate 78%. If we improve model routing we might +6-9% quality on the top 10k prompts (high impact).
Anna (Design): UX: any rollback will be visible to users. If we flip traffic quickly it's jarring. Prefer gradual ramp + visible banner for beta users.
Sam (SRE): Ops constraints: we have two safe playbooks. TL;DR: canary on Dedicated nodes -> regional ramp -> A/B split once stable. Suggested traffic strategy:
```
step1: canary 0.5% (dedicated), 6h
step2: extended canary 2% (24h) monitor p95 latency < 250ms, errors < 0.7%
step3: A/B 5% control vs variant (48h) check quality uplift + infra signals
step4: ramp 25% -> 50% -> 100% w/ rollback windows
fallback: route traffic to previous model variant + auto-scale extra capacity
```
deploy-bot: deploy started by @raj — canary group created on dedicated-gpu-03
Raj (Eng): RICE quick calc for 3 candidates:
- routing-tiling: Reach=210k, Impact=3, Confidence=0.6, Effort=4 -> RICE=(210000*3*0.6)/4 ~ 94500
- prompt-slice: Reach=80k, Impact=2, Confidence=0.8, Effort=2 -> RICE=(80000*2*0.8)/2 ~ 64000
- cache-keys: Reach=150k, Impact=1.5, Confidence=0.7, Effort=1 -> RICE=(150000*1.5*0.7)/1 ~ 157500
Raj (Eng): cache-keys jumps because low effort; but impact smaller. we should balance with strategic goals: reliability and lower token cost > small perf wins.
Olivia (PM): I think we pick cache-keys (low effort quick win), routing-tiling (high impact long term), and a small canary-only experiment for prompt-slice to collect data. Sequencing: cache -> canary routing -> A/B routing.
Maria (Data Science): can we add evaluation criteria? propose: quality_delta_on_core_eval >= +3% AND p95 latency change <= +10% AND token_cost_delta <= +5%.
Anna (Design): also add user-facing metrics: NPS survey for beta cohort + support-ticket delta.
Sam (SRE): agree. I'll write the rollout runbook and automated rollback playbooks. Want final decision by COB Fri so devs can spin up infra next week.
Olivia (PM): ok calling it: cache-keys, routing-tiling (canary first), prompt-slice micro-A/B. @raj @sam @maria please ack by EOD.
Raj (Eng): ack
Maria (Data Science): ack
Sam (SRE): ack :thumbsup:
Anna (Design): ack
